## 2026-09-26 — Native acknowledgement Flash spool implementation

The previous goal turn produced the validated history-count optimization and
six hardware trials; the latest user export also completed. Continuing the full
voice objective, inspection confirmed that the 8 KiB PCM ring paces fast-model
reception to playback and then drains before DeepSeek. Merely skipping the final
drain would overlap at most the small ring, while reusing engine scratch would
race the context composer.

Implemented 0.11.22-ack-spool: a bounded, board-owned IMA/CRC spool streams the
native contextual acknowledgement into unused clip-partition tail space. The
network worker closes fast WSS, validates/seals the full call and starts DeepSeek
while the audio owner drains Flash. Joins precede tools, final audio and all turn
exits. Actual protected recording length is checked before any erase. No new
task, heap audio buffer, simultaneous provider TLS session or partition change.

Host ASan/UBSan suite passed 40/40 (host-ack-spool-01.log). Additional full-length
recording preservation test passed: a worst-case 10-second lossless recording
uses321282B, remains byte-identical after a six-second acknowledgement, and
reopens with valid CRC. Random producer/consumer chunks match one-shot output,
every byte corruption of an encoded block is rejected, and partial NOR writes
remain unpublished with sticky failure. Host spool state400B; test-tone codec
SNR44.42dB is a numerical fixture metric, not a speech listening assessment.
Audio firmware build passed (build-ack-spool-01.log). Hardware acceptance pending.
